segments.sn35.236:1.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusmiṃ sati cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ … pe … jivhāya sati jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ … pe … manasmiṃ sati manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ … pe ….
segments.sn35.236:2.4: kucchismiṃ asati jighacchā pipāsā na paññāyati.
segments.sn35.236:2.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusmiṃ asati cakkhusamphassapaccayā nuppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ … pe … jivhāya asati jivhāsamphassapaccayā nuppajjati … pe … manasmiṃ asati manosamphassapaccayā nuppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhan”ti.

lines: Dasame na hotīti vuccamāne bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayavasena vuttaṃ.
Dvīsupi cetesu vipākasukhadukkhameva dassetvā vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ kathitanti.
